text_block_list.text:
Hauuu, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry! I 
lost...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:

just wouldn't move the way I wanted it to—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Just a little... J-Just for a moment, I... 
I thought it was truly all over, you 
see...

text_block_list.text:

my spirit almost broke halfway through...!

text_block_list.text:

r-run properly—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna give up like thiiis! I-I-I, 
I...!!
